_comment: token: create one at Account Settings -> Tokens. The Vercel CLI's session is not used - it expires within hours. Keep this file chmod 600.
_token_comment: Vercel account token; leave empty to read the named environment variable.
_token_env_comment: Environment variable that holds the Vercel token.
_teams_comment: Vercel team identifiers to include; empty uses the personal account.
_projects_comment: Project identifiers to include; empty includes every project in scope.
